reference.name: Tag search treats underscores and percent signs as wildcards
reference.summary: The Tags page search passes the query to the database LIKE pattern unescaped, so '_' matches any single character and '%' matches anything. Searching a_b also lists a-b and axb tags, v1_0_0 finds v1.0.0, and searching % or _ lists every tag.
reference.expected: Tag search treats '_' and '%' as literal characters, so it only lists tags whose names contain them.
reference.actual: With tags rel-a_b, rel-a-b and rel-axb, searching a_b listed all three ('3 Tags'), while a-b listed only rel-a-b. Searching % or _ listed all 5 tags, including ones with no percent sign or underscore. On harbor-handbook, v1_0_0 returned v1.0.0.
reproSteps: In a repository, create tags rel-a_b, rel-a-b and rel-axb (New Release > Create Tag Only).
Open the repository's Tags page, search for a_b and note the results.
Search for % and check whether tags without a percent sign are listed.

knownHits.reason: Matches tag search interpreting % and _ as wildcards and returning tags without those literal characters.

reference.name: Tags page uses plural grammar when one tag is listed
reference.summary: A repository with one tag displays the heading `1 Tags` while the nearby tab correctly displays `1 Tag`.
reference.expected: The tag heading should use singular grammar when exactly one tag exists.
reference.actual: A repository with one tag displays the heading `1 Tags` while the nearby tab correctly displays `1 Tag`.
reproSteps: Open an authenticated repository that contains exactly one tag.
Observe that the list heading says `1 Tags` while the nearby tab says `1 Tag`.

knownHits.reason: Matches the Tags list heading using '1 Tags' while the nearby tab correctly uses '1 Tag'.

reference.name: Duplicate-tag creation error describes the attempted operation as branch creation
reference.summary: Repeating Operations > Create tag with an existing tag name correctly rejects the duplicate but describes the attempted operation as creating a branch.
reference.expected: Duplicate-tag feedback identifies the attempted operation as tag creation and explains that the tag already exists.
reference.actual: The validation message says: Branch "<tag-name>" cannot be created as a tag with same name already exists in the repository.
reproSteps: Use the English locale and sign in with write access to an initialized, unarchived repository. Use a unique disposable tag name; the original observation used a 390×844 viewport.
Open a commit from the repository’s main branch, choose Operations > Create tag, enter the disposable tag name, and create it.
Return to the same commit, choose Operations > Create tag again, and submit the identical tag name.
Inspect the validation message. It says Branch "<tag-name>" cannot be created as a tag with same name already exists in the repository, despite the attempted operation being tag creation.

knownHits.reason: Matches Operations > Create tag rejecting an existing tag with feedback incorrectly describing branch creation.
